report: Three spruce trunks are down across the Fernwood Loop just past the second footbridge. Had to crawl under the biggest one.
label: trail_hazard

report: The switchbacks below Kettle Pass are glazed with ice at 7am. Nearly lost my footing twice, someone should put grit down.
label: trail_hazard

report: Hillside slumped onto the Cinder Ridge trail around mile 3. Half the tread is gone and there is a long drop on the downhill side.
label: trail_hazard

report: The plank bridge over Larkspur Creek has a rotten board in the middle. My foot went right through it.
label: trail_hazard

report: Black bear and two cubs foraging in the huckleberries about 200 yards below Kettle Pass junction, around 4pm. They ignored us and we backed away.
label: wildlife_sighting

report: Saw a pair of golden eagles circling over the Hollow Rim overlook this morning, one carried a snake.
label: wildlife_sighting

report: A herd of about 30 elk crossed the Marrow Meadow road at dusk, lots of calves among them.
label: wildlife_sighting

report: Moose cow standing in Tern Pond when we passed at lunchtime. Kept 50 yards back the whole time.
label: wildlife_sighting

report: The pit toilet at the Fernwood trailhead has no toilet paper and the door latch is broken off.
label: facility_issue

report: Trail sign at the Cinder Ridge fork has fallen over, and the arrow now points into the brush. New hikers will go the wrong way.
label: facility_issue

report: Water spigot at Blue Gate campground drips constantly and the whole tap area is a mud pit.
label: facility_issue

report: The trailhead parking lot lights at Marrow Meadow have been out all week, it is pitch dark by 6pm.
label: facility_issue

report: Found a blue insulated water bottle with a dented lid on the bench at Hollow Rim overlook. I left it at the visitor center desk.
label: lost_and_found

report: I lost my car key fob somewhere between Tern Pond and the Fernwood lot yesterday afternoon. Black fob with a red tag, please call if anyone hands it in.
label: lost_and_found

report: Picked up a child's yellow rain jacket on the Larkspur Creek path, it is hanging on the trailhead signpost.
label: lost_and_found

report: Did anyone turn in a pair of prescription sunglasses in a brown case? I think they fell out of my pack at Kettle Pass.
label: lost_and_found

report: Ranger Okafor gave our kids a junior naturalist talk at Tern Pond and they have not stopped talking about it. Thank you so much!
label: compliment

report: Best maintained trail we have hiked all summer. The new boardwalk on Marrow Meadow made it possible for my mother in her wheelchair.
label: compliment

report: Whoever repainted the trail markers on Cinder Ridge, thank you, I never doubted the route once.
label: compliment

report: The volunteer at the Blue Gate campground check-in went out of her way to find us a flat tent site. Lovely welcome.
label: compliment

report: Do I need a permit to fly a small camera drone over Hollow Rim for a wedding photo shoot?

report: Is there a shuttle from the visitor center to the Fernwood trailhead on weekdays in October?
label: other

report: You should add a short loop for families near the visitor center, something under a mile.

report: What time does the park gate close in November? Our flight lands late and we want to camp.
